page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right; marginal notes in the right margin beside the verb paradigms (Indicat., Verberor, Verberabar, Verberabar tus sum, Verberabar tus eram).

main_text.p: ueni ignem:feriens lapidem, improprie dicimus. Congruunt tamen deponentium & communium participia, φωνήσας loquutus, κλέψας furatus, καταφιλήσας, osculatus.
main_text.head: INDICATIVVS PASSIVVS. Indicat.
Præsens.
main_text.p: τύπτομαι τύπτη uel τύπτεαι Ionice, Verberor uel τύπτει Attice, τύπτεται.
τυπτόμεθα, uel Ionice τυπτόμεσθα, τύπτεσθε τύπτονται Imperfectum.
ἐτυπτόμην ἐτύπτῃ ἐτύπτεο Ionice, Verberabar ἐτύπτεν Dorice, ἐτύπτετο

p.i: Perfectum de quo fusius cap. 4. fol. 205.

page.notes: Greek forms transcribed as printed; some accents and breathings in the paradigm are doubtful due to print quality, notably in the Perfectum and Plusquamperfectum rows. Marginal notes beside the paradigms are partly cut off at the edge and read as best possible.
